verdict.rationale: OpenRouter is API-first, and many UI functions have documented API equivalents. Inference, streaming, routing and fallbacks are all API-driven. The model catalog is exposed via GET /api/v1/models. API keys can be managed programmatically, including per-key limits that the community confirms. Data-policy restrictions can be set per request, mirroring the account-wide privacy setting. A published OpenAPI spec and an MCP server for credits and rankings round this out. However, some controls are documented only as UI or account settings, with no API equivalent shown, and there is no explicit statement of full API–UI parity. missing for 10: API equivalents for account-level settings (training/data policy, workspace budgets, BYOK setup), programmatic analytics/usage and credit purchase, an explicit parity guarantee, independent hands-on confirmation of parity.
